name: QuizSystem AI
summary: A clear path from questions to results.
description: An assessment platform for creating quizzes, tracking attempts, and processing results through a modular backend.
technologies: .NET 8 / .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, Razor Pages, SQL Server
challenge: Assessment authoring and result processing need different workflows while sharing reliable data and clear application boundaries.
approach: Custom CQRS separates reads from writes. Dedicated query handlers support attempt tracking and result retrieval, with Razor Pages providing the interface.
imageAlt: Interface concept showing a quiz builder and attempt review with fictional sample data
